class.name: AnimationStateContext
class.description: [AnimationStateContext] encapsulates live playback information (such as target node, active mixer, elapsed time, duration, frame delta, and blend weight) passed to [AnimationStateEvent] virtual methods ([method AnimationStateEvent._start], [method AnimationStateEvent._update], [method AnimationStateEvent._end], [method AnimationStateEvent._cancel]).

members.member: The frame delta time of the current playback tick.
The total duration (in seconds) of this state event keyframe.
The time elapsed (in seconds) since the state event started.
The target [Object] (usually a [Node]) bound to the animation track.
The current blend weight of the animation during playback.
